post.summary: Registers a new user with email and password
post.description:
Sample request:

    POST /api/Identity/register
    FormData:
    - FirstName: "John"
    - LastName: "Doe"
    - Email: "john.doe@example.com"
    - Password: "P@ssw0rd!"
    - PhoneNumber: "123-456-7890"
    - Role: 0 (Student) or 1 (Instructor)
    - ProfilePicture: [file upload]

400.description: Invalid input data or registration error
